caption: Several flashes of lightning light up a stormy sky over a highway one after another, each one lighting the wet road for an instant.

sa.check: A highway under a stormy sky.
Lightning flashes in the sky more than once.
Each flash lights the wet road.
The road looks wet: shiny or streaked with reflections.
The flashes come one after another, with darker sky between them.

pc.expect: Each flash is separate and brief: the sky brightens, returns to dark, and brightens again; between flashes the scene is at its dark storm level.
pc.fail: The flashes merge into a steady glow that lasts to the end of the clip; or the sky brightens steadily without dropping back; or a flash fades in slowly like a dimmer; or the sky turns to daylight.

pc.expect: The road, its markings, the vehicles and the roadside are the same across dark and lit frames; each flash reveals the same scene.
pc.fail: Vehicles appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or lane markings jump to new places; or roadside signs or poles appear or vanish; or the road bends differently between frames.

pc.expect: The wet road mirrors each flash: bright streaks and patches lie on the surface below the lit sky, during the flash only.
pc.fail: The sky flashes while the wet road stays as dark as before; or the road lights up while the sky stays dark; or the road's reflection stays lit after the sky is dark.

pc.expect: Vehicles keep their direction and lane through each flash; headlights and tail lights stay steady.
pc.fail: A vehicle jumps ahead or back between dark and lit frames; or changes direction at a flash; or its headlights go out at the flash and return afterwards.
pc.precondition: Vehicles are moving on the highway.

pc.expect: Vehicles, signs and the road keep their shapes; nothing passes through anything; any bolt seen ends at the ground or in the air, not inside a vehicle or structure.
pc.fail: A vehicle changes shape or merges with another; or a bolt passes through a vehicle or bridge and lights it like a lamp; or the road surface turns into open water; or a sign morphs into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The road surface, the vehicles' colours and the roadside keep their colours apart from brightness.
pc.fail: A vehicle changes colour; or the lane markings change colour; or the sky changes colour permanently after a flash.
